name: Takatsuki Taeko
source:
[b]The S-Class Closet Pervert[/b]

Occupation: Student preparing for entrance exams
Height: About average
Breasts: Slightly smaller than others

Taeko is a studious examinee who has come to Yunagi-sou to focus on her studies, even though her home is nearby. She's so serious about her education that she deliberately changes her environment. However, beneath her diligent exterior lies a secret: she's quite the closet pervert.

As fate would have it, this young lady lives in Yunagi-sou, where the ratio of girls to boys is skewed heavily in favor of the girls. It's only a matter of time before her true nature is revealed. Night after night, she strains her ears to catch the "erotic moans" emanating from beyond the walls. Eventually, the lewd desires she desperately tried to suppress become too much to contain.

[Translated from official website]
